summary: The ZCode task for WD-01 p3b (9851fc01) evaluated the native Part A v0 HOLDOUT (5 roots) against its brief: before the required diagnostics, before REGISTRATION_P3_v2, before the validation gate, and with the defective run-1 weights. The task was cancelled by the reviewer at 22:18Z.

under_registration.status: superseded; its TTC<1.5 s rule was degenerate (p2C data-card TTC erratum) and the brief required a v2 registration first

with_weights.description: p3 run-1 members (trained 20:14-20:48Z, before the reviewer stop), known defective
defects: lane change keeps s across lanes with different origins (accel->main_right merge teleports ~2266 m upstream)
per-vehicle lane length/limit/cap not refreshed after a lane change (merged vehicles dropped as exits at s>454)
speed limits set to observed maxima (33.79/24.0) instead of network limits (31.29/22.22)

headline_numbers_of_defective_model: ensemble-mean speed RMSE 14.7 m/s at H=30 vs min(persistence, IDM) 5.49; predicted collisions 21.8-49.2 per 1000 vehicle-steps; recommendation: no horizon passes
use_in_decisions: none. No model, hyperparameter, threshold or design choice used these numbers. The engine defects were found by code review of engine.py, not from the holdout output.
files_retained: all three output files and the run-1 weights are kept unchanged as evidence (also copied at weights/run1_stopped/)

decision.by: main discussion (delegated overnight; owner may override)
terms: one further registered holdout evaluation is allowed, disclosed as the SECOND use of these 5 roots
REGISTRATION_P3_v2 is frozen and hashed before it, with pass criteria RELATIVE TO BASELINES ONLY (nothing informed by the leaked absolute numbers)
it runs only after p3c passes its validation gate
it is NOT run until the owner has reviewed this deviation (morning of 2026-09-26); it is prepared as a single command
a physical holdout block is added: the loader refuses holdout roots unless given a registration hash; it is tested

prevention: Future WD briefs call a loader that raises on holdout roots without a valid registration hash; reviewers stop tasks whose validation is implausible before any holdout step is reachable.

summary: The native Part A validation split (4 roots: cv20_7005m2000, cv20_7006m2000, cv30_7305m2700, seed_7535m2400) has been scored against a gate repeatedly during model development. Hyperparameters were always fitted on TRAIN, and spread factors on a TRAIN-internal calibration split, but design choices were informed by validation results.

validation_looks.gate: old gate (claimed PASS, rejected by reviewer)

validation_looks.verdict: FAIL on TTC<3 coverage only; old gate PASS
VAL look #7: H=30 FAIL on (b) LC +39.6%; (a),(c),(d) PASS
NO validation look (timed out during TRAIN-internal iteration)
NO validation look; TRAIN-internal gate v2 PASS (3 selection iterations on calibration roots)
VAL look #8: H=30 FAIL on (c) delay coverage 0.769 < 0.80 (TTC 0.808, CRPS pass); (a),(b) +15.1%,(d) PASS; H=60 PASS all; old gate H=30 PASS

consequence: The validation gate verdict is optimistic by an unknown amount (garden of forking paths). The holdout (5 roots) remains the single clean confirmation: its disclosed second use (DEV-1), frozen baseline-relative registration, only after validation passes.
truth_regime_note: The native Part A truth comes from controller_verification native windows (60-600 s). Chunk-1 campaign data is CAV speedMode 31 (pre-fix). Close-call (TTC<3) fixes must be re-checked on speedMode-27 data (chunk 2) before being treated as final; windows with CAVs braking at the decel cap are to be tagged in the next evaluation.
